description: Stage-1 bonus all-three-broken variant (ticket #124 / F52): identical to sf-win-04 through Mike match win and 0x41740 entry at 17484 (and input 17581), then walks right at 17594 and breaks the right stack (0x18e24, +1,000) with standing HK at 17667, walks left at 17680 and breaks the lower-left stack (0x18e64, +1,000) with crouching HP at 17768, and jumps left at 17790 to break the upper-left stack (0x18e44, +3,000 to bonus and P1 score) with jump HP at 17833, triggering the 0x3baf6 early exit at 17834, settle at 17857, BONUS PTS. 5000 at 17867, clear at 17987, and 0x3efc4 stage_step to stage 2 at 18107. Continuous checkpoints 17483..=18110.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.

machine.dipswitches: factory defaults; observed readback DSW1=0xdfff, DSW2=0xffff

inputs.comment: insert coin; title screen is up from ~1375
confirm default country Japan at country select (visible by ~1860)
bonus-1 plank break press (power 10, success branch 0x410b6-0x41220)
walk right to right stack (0x18e24 at cx=0x180, cy=0xa0)
standing HK (mv 0x16): breaks right stack (0x18e24, +1,000) at frame 17667
turn left and walk left to screen clamp (cx=0xc0)
crouching HP (mv 0x1c): breaks lower-left stack (0x18e64, +1,000) at frame 17768
jump HP (mv 0x21): breaks upper-left stack (0x18e44, +3,000) at frame 17833
